links.outcome: Prevalence of LLM use and presence of institutional LLM policies among rheumatologists
links.effect: 89.6% reported prior LLM use, while only 9.9% reported established institutional policies on LLM use.
links.quote: While usage is widespread, only 9.9% reported established institutional policies on LLMs use.

links.outcome: Concern about loss of traditional clinical skills from LLM reliance
links.effect: 81.1% of both users and nonusers shared concerns regarding potential loss of traditional clinical skills.
links.quote: Although both groups shared concerns regarding the potential loss of traditional clinical skills (81.1%), active users significantly favored the integration of mandatory LLMs training into core rheumatology curricula.

unlisted_practices: Integrating mandatory LLM training into core rheumatology curricula
Developing competency frameworks for LLM use in clinical practice

screen.reason: An international survey evaluating clinicians' actual use, institutional governance, and training needs regarding LLMs in rheumatology practice.
